comparison.objective: Open a bottle by lowering a detented safety loop and pressing a separate rocker while keeping it upright; candidate sifts a mixed load.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential manipulation of two passive latches while stabilizing a free bottle versus simultaneous load sharing, orientation control and particle passage.
comparison.success_condition: Loop displaced and lid opened >60° for 0.4 seconds without tilt, support loss or excessive force versus ≥98% recovery, retained washers, no spill and 3-second supported release.
comparison.reason: The record tests sequential unlatching of an articulated closure, not material separation; generic stabilization does not make the tested abilities equivalent.
